en-US.description: The AI work platform built for advanced enterprises.
en-US.longDescription: NamiWork Enterprise is a 360 AI work platform for enterprises. Every employee can build AI experts that understand their own business using everyday language; experts accumulate in multi-user projects, are shared across departments, work directly inside connected business systems, and are governed by an enterprise console that allocates cloud hosts, compute, and models, with on-premises or isolated-cloud deployment, tiered permissions, and auditable actions.

zh-CN.description: 给先进企业打造的 AI 工作台。
zh-CN.longDescription: 纳米Work 企业版是 360 打造的企业级 AI 工作台。每位员工都可以用日常语言养成理解自身业务的 AI 专家，专家在多人项目中沉淀、在部门间共享、通过连接器直接读写工作系统，并由企业专属后台统一分配云主机、算力与模型，支持本地内网或云端隔离部署，权限分级、操作可审计。
zh-CN.name: 纳米Work企业版
